gdp_real_growth.analytical_context: Headline momentum. Must be compared against Final Sales to detect inventory-driven illusions.

core_pce_inflation.target_description: Personal consumption expenditures excluding food and energy
core_pce_inflation.analytical_context: The Fed's preferred sticky inflation metric. Drives rate-cut/hike probabilities.

personal_income_monthly.analytical_context: High-frequency monthly proxy. Critical for running bridge equations to nowcast quarterly GDP.

savings_rate_monthly.analytical_context: Consumer buffer. Structural depletion signals forced future spending contractions.

final_sales_domestic.analytical_context: True structural demand. Strips out trade deficits and inventory noise.

change_inventories.analytical_context: Supply chain gluts. Unusual spikes here often precede future GDP contractions as firms halt production.
